candidate_name: Bahria Foundation LNG Terminal (Sonmiani / Charna Island FSRU)
sponsor_or_proposer: Bahria Foundation (charitable trust linked to the Pakistan Navy)
current_state: One of six LNG import proposals floated for Pakistan circa 2017-2018 (alongside ExxonMobil/Energas, Shell/Engro FSRU 2, Trafigura/GasPort 2, Total, Mitsubishi/Tabeer). Bahria reportedly planned a 170,000 m3 FSRU receiving facility, variously sited at Sonmiani (Balochistan) or Charna Island (~45 km west of Karachi), with a proposed 310 km pipeline link to Nawabshah. No reporting of a concrete step (no MOU/FEED/permit/site lease) and no fresh activity located since 2018; apparently dormant.
missing_threshold_elements: Location ambiguous (Sonmiani vs Charna Island vs Port Qasim, never fixed); no concrete step beyond a verbal/announced intent; no activity in the last ~8 years (likely shelved/dead). Sponsor IS identified (Bahria Foundation).
watch_for: Any revived Bahria Foundation / Pakistan Navy LNG filing, a fixed site (Sonmiani vs Charna), an OGRA terminal licence, or the Nawabshah pipeline tender resurfacing. Re-check 2026-12.
notes: Distinct from all 11 existing GEM Pakistan terminals (no Bahria/Sonmiani/Charna record in the export; dedup_index + grep clear).
